name: LockBit
description: LockBit is a ransomware-as-a-service cybercriminal organization believed to be based in Russia. The world's most prolific ransomware group in 2022, responsible for approximately 44% of all ransomware incidents globally and $91 million in US ransom payments between 2020 and 2023. Disrupted by Operation Cronos in February 2024 when law enforcement seized infrastructure and arrested members.
